claims.evidence: Witness photos show orange LPG cylinders with wear, but do not show the cylinder size/capacity (kg) or any readable markings confirming 12.5kg.
Photos show dents/scratches/scuffs, but do not provide leak test results, pressure test results, or valve/regulator functional checks.
Only general physical wear is visible; no certification/compliance tags or condition verification beyond surface marks.

risks.risk: Capacity/size may not be 12.5kg (pricing depends heavily on kg size).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity (kg) and model/grade markings on the body (and/or the neck/shoulder stamp).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-size foreign-used cylinder (worst-case size for value) and treat as not confirmed for the stated capacity.

risks.risk: Cylinders may be empty or not filled (affects immediate usability and value).
risks.proof: A photo showing the cylinder gauge/indicator if present, or a receipt/label indicating fill status; alternatively a video showing the cylinder being weighed (scale reading visible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as empty/unknown fill status (worst-case for buyer convenience).

risks.risk: Valve/regulator/hose may be missing, damaged, or non-functional (photos don’t confirm thread condition or functionality).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the valve threads and the regulator/hose connection points, plus a short clip showing the regulator attached and no visible leaks (soap-bubble test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as cylinder-only or as not guaranteed functional regulator/hose (worst-case: buyer may need replacements).

risks.risk: Leak/safety risk due to dents, scuffs, or valve condition (photos show wear but no leak test).
risks.proof: A leak test result: video of soap-bubble test around valve/regulator connection with no bubbles, or a pressure/leak test report.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unsafe/untested until leak test is shown; assume buyer will require testing before use.

risks.risk: Certification/inspection/compliance status may be expired or missing (affects acceptance and resale).
risks.proof: Clear photos of any inspection stamps, certification tags, expiry dates, or compliance markings on the cylinder.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no verifiable compliance/inspection (worst-case for regulatory/safety confidence).

risks.risk: Quantity included may be more or fewer than what’s shown (photos show at least two but not confirmed full set).
risks.proof: A wide shot showing all cylinders included in the sale, counted clearly, with the same angle showing the complete set.
risks.if_unproven: Price for the minimum confirmed quantity shown (worst-case: only the cylinders visible in photos are included).

risks.risk: Accessories (stand, protective cap, hose, regulator) may be missing or in poor condition.
risks.proof: Photos listing and showing each accessory included, with close-ups of condition (especially hose/regulator ends and protective cap).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming accessories are not included or not guaranteed usable.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity (kg) and any model/grade markings.
Photo/video confirming whether the cylinders are filled (or show fill/weight evidence).
Close-up of valve threads and the regulator/hose connection; include a short clip showing regulator attached.
Leak test proof: soap-bubble test video around valve/regulator connection with no bubbles.
Photos of any inspection/certification/expiry/compliance tags or stamps.
Wide shot showing the full number of cylinders included in the sale (count clearly).
Photos of included accessories (hose, regulator, stand, protective cap) and their condition.
response.reason: The witness confirms the item type (orange LPG cylinders) but key pricing drivers—capacity (kg), fill status, and whether regulator/hose are included and functional—are not visible or verifiable from the report. Without those proof points, a worst-case price would be unreliable.
